title: The evolutionary processes of bacterial aromatic polyketide ketosynthases.
authors: Wang, Xiaoyu; Gao, Qiandi; Ge, Liangjun; Qin, Zhiwei
one_liner_zh: 该文利用蛋白语言模型算法MAAPE分析细菌芳香聚酮合酶KS/CLF的进化过程，虽以蛋白质序列/结构进化为对象并涉及AI方法，但核心是进化生物学问题而非蛋白质结构计算建模，对结构设计仅有间接启发。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The biosynthesis of bacterial aromatic polyketides (type II polyketides, T2PKs) employs a single set of catalysts (ketosynthases, KSs or KS(alpha), with chain length factors, CLFs or KS(beta)) and iteratively assembles a carbon backbone with precise chain length control. Considering the increasing number of T2PKs discovered in laboratory settings, it is necessary to understand the evolutionary trajectories of KSs and CLFs. RESULTS: We employ our recently developed algorithm, MAAPE, based on large protein language model to glean insights into the evolution process of KSs and CLFs. Our findings indicate the evolutionary history of KS and CLF domains from bacterial T2PKSs and identify a shared ancestral cluster (Cluster A), supporting a common origin. Despite structural homology, KSs and CLFs followed distinct evolutionary paths, shaped by coevolution and early horizontal gene transfer. CONCLUSIONS: Understanding the evolutionary lineage of these enzymes will illuminate the natural optimization processes of their functions and present opportunities for the rational design of novel polyketides with enhanced efficacy.
abstract_zh: 背景：细菌芳香族聚酮化合物（II型聚酮化合物，T2PKs）的生物合成利用一套单一的催化剂（酮合酶，KSs或KS(α)，以及链长因子，CLFs或KS(β)），并迭代组装碳骨架，实现精确的链长控制。鉴于实验室环境中发现的T2PKs数量不断增加，理解KSs和CLFs的进化轨迹十分必要。结果：我们采用最近开发的基于大型蛋白质语言模型的算法MAAPE，深入探究KSs和CLFs的进化过程。我们的发现揭示了细菌T2PKSs中KS和CLF结构域的进化历史，并识别出一个共享的祖先簇（Cluster A），支持其共同起源。尽管存在结构同源性，KSs和CLFs遵循了不同的进化路径，这些路径受共进化和早期水平基因转移的影响。结论：理解这些酶的进化谱系将阐明其功能的自然优化过程，并为合理设计具有增强功效的新型聚酮化合物提供机会。
